questions.q: Is there a feature, product, tool or invention you really admire, and why?
questions.say: AI coding agents that can be extended with skills and the Model Context Protocol. What I admire is the design: instead of one giant model doing everything, an open protocol lets the agent plug into browsers, research tools, documentation and my own workflows. It changed how I work: I describe the outcome, the agent builds and tests it, and I review and decide.
questions.note: Pick the one you can talk about with genuine enthusiasm; a concrete 'it changed how I work' story lands best.

questions.q: How do you use AI in your day-to-day work?
questions.say: I treat AI as a team: a coding agent builds and tests, research tools gather sources, and I review, decide and ship. I keep secrets out of code, test before deploying, and verify AI output against primary sources.
